title: A Bad Day Was Never the Whole Truth
north_star: A soft illustrated archive of Aachu and Zuv's love, chaos, culture and tiny rituals.
human_truth: Love can remain true on a day when two tired people genuinely dislike each other and make the room harder to live in.
emotional_arc: automatic care under irritation -> self-recognition -> cramped mutual obstruction -> hurt amplified into consequence -> equal repair without denied anger -> the wider relationship survives the frame
format_shell: Six-slide causal single-evening sequence: Narrow Orbit.
visual_style: One cinematic rainy-evening room sequence in Observational Intimacy Premium watercolor-and-ink, motivated cool window and warm practical lamp light.
proof_engine: A shared extension cord progresses from slack to taut to unplugged to jointly restored; body distance and light change with it.
relationship_motion: Aachu and Zuv both care automatically, both obstruct, both escalate and both repair. Neither is the problem or the handler.
public_send_reason: Send this to the person who knows that one ugly mood never gets to narrate the whole relationship.

story_selling_decision.selector_verdict: Narrow Orbit turns a familiar conflict truth into one ownable, visibly causal evening.
